subject: dispatch_after

observation.summary: _dispatch_after is defined in __TEXT,__text at arm64e offset 0x0001AE2D; the public C name dispatch_after resolves via underscore rename. The post-2014 wall-clock variant dispatch_after_f with a dispatch_clock_t argument shares the same entry trampoline.

claim: dispatch_after is exported by libdispatch (macOS 27 / arm64e) as _dispatch_after at offset 0x1AE2D, with the public name dispatch_after resolving through Apple's leading-underscore rename. The post-Apple-2014 clock-based variant dispatch_after(dispatch_time_t when, ...) accepts a dispatch_clock_t-like parameter and is implemented via _dispatch_after (OSS source.c:1402); it is the OSS-only reason _dispatch_source_type_after exists in source.c:1429 even though the shipped binary has stripped that source-type anchor (see dispatch_source_type_data_add record).
